```{r}
inputs <- readRDS(params$inputs_path)
bundle_root <- dirname(dirname(params$inputs_path))
read_output <- function(name) {
  path <- inputs$outputs[[name]]
  if (is.null(path)) return(NULL)
  utils::read.csv(file.path(bundle_root, path), check.names = FALSE)
}
output_path <- function(name) {
  path <- inputs$outputs[[name]]
  if (is.null(path)) return(NULL)
  file.path(bundle_root, path)
}
module_record <- function(name) {
  matches <- which(vapply(
    inputs$module_status,
    function(record) identical(record$module, name),
    logical(1)
  ))
  inputs$module_status[[matches[[1L]]]]
}
module_context <- function(name, interpretation) {
  record <- module_record(name)
  cat(
    "**Result status:** ", gsub("_", " ", record$status),
    "  \n**Spatial resolution:** ", gsub("_", " ", record$actual_resolution),
    "  \n",
    sep = ""
  )
  if (!is.null(record$reason)) {
    cat("**Warning or omission:** ", record$reason, "  \n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("**Interpretation:** ", interpretation, "\n\n", sep = "")
}
status_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(inputs$module_status, function(record) {
  data.frame(
    analysis = gsub("_", " ", record$module),
    status = gsub("_", " ", record$status),
    resolution = gsub("_", " ", record$actual_resolution),
    explanation = if (is.null(record$reason)) {
      "Completed as specified."
    } else {
      record$reason
    },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
```

## Summary

This run retained **`r format(inputs$event_count, big.mark = ",")` operational
detection events** from **`r inputs$physical_location_count` physical camera
locations**. Results requested at `r gsub("_", " ", inputs$resolution)`
resolution cover **`r inputs$analysis_unit_count` analytical units**.

The evidence contains `r format(inputs$operation_state_counts[["active"]],
big.mark = ",")` confirmed active analysis-unit days,
`r format(inputs$operation_state_counts[["inactive"]], big.mark = ",")`
confirmed inactive days, and
`r format(inputs$operation_state_counts[["unknown"]], big.mark = ",")` days
with unknown operation. Unknown operation was not counted as sampling effort.

```{r}
attention <- status_table[status_table$status != "completed", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(attention) > 0L) {
  knitr::kable(attention, caption = "Results needing attention")
}
```

## Sampling and observed richness

### Where sampling occurred

```{r}
map_path <- output_path("point_map")
if (!is.null(map_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(map_path)
} else {
  cat(module_record("point_map")$reason)
}
```

```{r}
module_context(
```


### How effort and detections differed

```{r}
effort <- read_output("effort_coverage")
richness <- read_output("observed_richness")
if (!is.null(effort)) {
  effort_display <- effort[c(
    "analysis_unit_id", "confirmed_active_days", "unknown_days"
  )]
  if (!is.null(richness)) {
    effort_display <- merge(
      effort_display,
      richness[c("analysis_unit_id", "observed_richness")],
      by = "analysis_unit_id",
      all.x = TRUE,
      sort = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    effort_display$observed_richness <- NA_integer_
  }
  ordered_units <- effort_display$analysis_unit_id[
    order(effort_display$confirmed_active_days, method = "radix")
  ]
  effort_plot <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      analysis_unit_id = effort_display$analysis_unit_id,
      measure = "Confirmed active days",
      value = effort_display$confirmed_active_days
    ),
    data.frame(
      analysis_unit_id = effort_display$analysis_unit_id,
      measure = "Days with unknown operation",
      value = effort_display$unknown_days
    ),
    data.frame(
      analysis_unit_id = effort_display$analysis_unit_id,
      measure = "Observed species",
      value = effort_display$observed_richness
    )
  )
  effort_plot$analysis_unit_id <- factor(
    effort_plot$analysis_unit_id,
    levels = ordered_units
  )
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    effort_plot,
    ggplot2::aes(x = value, y = analysis_unit_id, fill = measure)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.72, na.rm = TRUE) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(. ~ measure, scales = "free_x") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Confirmed active days" = "#287271",
      "Days with unknown operation" = "#D9894E",
      "Observed species" = "#6C5B7B"
    )) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Analysis unit") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
module_context(
  "effort_coverage",
  paste(
    "Effort is confirmed active time at the selected analytical resolution;",
    "unknown operation is not effort. Unequal effort limits direct comparison."
  )
)
module_context(
  "observed_richness",
  paste(
    "Observed richness is the number of species detected in the supplied,",
    "effort-filtered records. It is not an estimate of species that went",
    "undetected."
  )
)
```

A sampled unit with no detections has zero observed richness. A unit without a
confirmed active day is excluded rather than treated as an ecological absence.
Observed richness is not an estimate of species that went undetected.
The complete effort and richness tables remain in the machine-readable bundle.

## Detected community differences

```{r}
#| results: asis
jaccard <- read_output("jaccard")
if (!is.null(jaccard) && nrow(jaccard) > 0L) {
  units <- unique(as.character(jaccard$analysis_unit_id_1))
  jaccard$analysis_unit_id_1 <- factor(
    jaccard$analysis_unit_id_1,
    levels = rev(units)
  )
  jaccard$analysis_unit_id_2 <- factor(
    jaccard$analysis_unit_id_2,
    levels = units
  )
  print(ggplot2::ggplot(
    jaccard,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = analysis_unit_id_2,
      y = analysis_unit_id_1,
      fill = jaccard_dissimilarity
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.35) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#F2EFE9",
      high = "#2D5F73",
      limits = c(0, 1),
      na.value = "#D7D7D7",
      name = "Jaccard\ndissimilarity"
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_equal() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Analysis unit", y = "Analysis unit") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ))

  between_units <- jaccard$jaccard_dissimilarity[
    as.character(jaccard$analysis_unit_id_1) !=
      as.character(jaccard$analysis_unit_id_2) &
      is.finite(jaccard$jaccard_dissimilarity)
  ]
  if (length(between_units) > 0L) {
    cat(
      "\n\nAmong different analysis units, detected-composition dissimilarity ",
      "ranged from **", sprintf("%.2f", min(between_units)), "** to **",
      sprintf("%.2f", max(between_units)), "**. Darker cells indicate fewer ",
      "detected species in common.\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
} else {
  cat(module_record("jaccard")$reason)
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
module_context(
  "jaccard",
  paste(
    "Jaccard describes differences in detected species composition. It is not",
    "standardized for unequal effort, sampling completeness, or detectability",
    "and does not establish environmental causes."
  )
)
```

These descriptive differences do not establish environmental causes.

## Operational-event detection rates

```{r}
#| results: asis
rates <- read_output("operational_event_detection_rate")
if (!is.null(rates) && nrow(rates) > 0L) {
  rates <- rates[order(
    rates$events_per_100_active_days,
    decreasing = TRUE,
    na.last = TRUE
  ), ]
  top_rates <- utils::head(rates, 12L)
  top_rates$display_label <- paste0(
    top_rates$species,
    " @ ", top_rates$physical_location_id,
    " (", top_rates$confirmed_active_days, " active days)"
  )
  top_rates$display_label <- factor(
    top_rates$display_label,
    levels = rev(top_rates$display_label)
  )
  print(ggplot2::ggplot(
    top_rates,
    ggplot2::aes(x = events_per_100_active_days, y = display_label)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#3E7C59", width = 0.72) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Operational events per 100 confirmed active days",
      y = "Species @ physical location (effort denominator)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank()))
  cat("\n\n", paste(
    "These are the 12 highest already-emitted physical-location/species rates;",
    "no rates were pooled across locations. The complete table remains in the",
    "bundle."
  ), "\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat(module_record("operational_event_detection_rate")$reason)
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
module_context(
  "operational_event_detection_rate",
  paste(
    "These are detections of operational events per confirmed camera effort.",
    "They must not be interpreted as abundance, density, or population trend."
  )
)
```

Operational-event detection rates must not be interpreted as abundance or density.

## Broad day/night patterns

```{r}
#| results: asis
diel <- read_output("coarse_day_night")
if (!is.null(diel) && nrow(diel) > 0L) {
  pair_totals <- stats::aggregate(
    event_count ~ physical_location_id + species,
    data = diel,
    FUN = sum
  )
  pair_totals <- pair_totals[order(
    pair_totals$event_count,
    decreasing = TRUE,
    method = "radix"
  ), ]
  selected_pairs <- utils::head(pair_totals, 12L)
  selected_keys <- paste(
    selected_pairs$physical_location_id,
    selected_pairs$species,
    sep = "\r"
  )
  diel$display_key <- paste(diel$physical_location_id, diel$species, sep = "\r")
  diel_display <- diel[diel$display_key %in% selected_keys, , drop = FALSE]
  label_lookup <- paste0(
    selected_pairs$species,
    " @ ", selected_pairs$physical_location_id,
    " (", selected_pairs$event_count, " events)"
  )
  names(label_lookup) <- selected_keys
  diel_display$display_label <- factor(
    label_lookup[diel_display$display_key],
    levels = rev(label_lookup)
  )
  print(ggplot2::ggplot(
    diel_display,
    ggplot2::aes(x = event_proportion, y = display_label, fill = period)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      labels = function(value) paste0(round(100 * value), "%"),
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(day = "#E3B23C", night = "#345995"),
      name = "Period"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Share of classified operational events",
      y = "Species @ physical location (classified events)"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank()))
  cat(
    "\n\nThe plot selects the 12 physical-location/species pairs with the most ",
    "classified events and displays their already-emitted proportions. Nothing ",
    "was pooled across locations; the complete table remains in the bundle.\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(module_record("coarse_day_night")$reason)
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
diel_basis <- if (identical(inputs$diel_method, "flash")) {
  paste(
    "Day versus night is based on the supplied flash indicator. It is a broad",
    "light-condition summary, not precise clock-based activity timing."
  )
} else {
  paste(
    "Day versus night is based on the configured clock rule. It is a broad",
    "category and does not support fine-scale diel inference."
  )
}
module_context("coarse_day_night", diel_basis)
```

## Analysis status and limits

```{r}
knitr::kable(status_table)
```

An omitted analysis lacked the evidence needed for a defensible result. A
completed-with-warnings result remains usable only within the explanation shown
beside it. Detailed source, repair, entity, effort, event-membership,
configuration, and fixity evidence is kept separately in the audit bundle.

- Camera-trap non-detection does not prove ecological absence.
- Coarse day/night categories do not support fine-scale diel inference.
- Species accumulation describes sampling accumulation, not unseen richness.
- Point maps show supplied physical locations and do not interpolate habitat.
- No result in this report estimates abundance, density, population trend, or
  causal habitat response.
